basics.name: Lemmuel Turaya
basics.label: Full-Stack & Mobile App Developer
basics.summary: Full-stack and mobile developer with 6+ years shipping production platforms across logistics, real estate, marketing, and education. Specializes in Vue.js / Nuxt.js + Laravel on the web, Flutter on mobile, and clean REST API design. Also builds autonomous AI-engineer pipelines — a production multi-LLM agent system (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Qwen) wired into a real ticketing workflow with security gates and independent test verification. Open to remote, hybrid, or onsite roles.

work.name: AAI Worldwide Logistics
work.summary: Contribute to the development and enhancement of the company's Financial Management System, connected logistics platforms, and a new Flutter-based Warehouse Management mobile app — integrating SAP and third-party services with internal applications.
highlights: Designing and shipping a Flutter-based Warehouse Management System (WMS) mobile app from concept to production, enabling real-time inventory, receiving, and pick/pack operations on the warehouse floor.
Adopted Vibe Coding — AI-assisted delivery with Claude AI — to compress prototyping and refactoring cycles while keeping code review, tests, and engineering judgment in the loop.

Designed and implemented key FMS features — journal voucher creation, sundry expense invoice processing, inventory management, and reporting using Ag-Grid for data visualization and jsPDF for advanced reports.
Facilitated SAP-to-WMS order integration by converting XML payloads to JSON, generating updated XML files, and managing secure SFTP transfers for SAP validation.
Built CRM maintenance modules for Airline Rates, IATA Rates, and associated charges; created customizable forms with SurveyJS for Customer Service Representatives.
Developed a Trucking Rates module within the TMS using Vuetify for the front-end and Laravel for back-end logic.

projects.name: Autonomous AI Engineer (Ticketing)
projects.description: Multi-LLM autonomous AI agent pipeline wired into a production ticketing system. `php artisan ai:work {ref}` picks up ASSIGNED tickets, auto-detects the target repository, dispatches to the operator-chosen brain (Claude / Gemini / OpenAI / OpenRouter / Qwen), persists per-ticket chat memory, and a separate `ai:verify` command runs the real PHPUnit suite before any merge.
highlights: 5 LLM brains wired in behind one AiHarnessService — Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Qwen
Security gate at command boundary — only ASSIGNED-status tickets are pickable
Auto repo detection from the systems table — no cross-repo drift
AIChatMemory Eloquent model persists per-ticket conversation history
Independent verifier runs `php artisan test` (or custom --cmd), logs pass/fail to the ticket comment thread
tickets:auto-close cron closes deployed tickets after 72 hours

highlights: ~68 Eloquent models, ~99 controllers, ~98 migrations, ~324 Vue pages across 20+ domain folders
Velzon admin theme on Vue CLI; AG Grid Enterprise tables; Sanctum bearer auth
Costing engine: Costing → CostingCost → CostingDetails → CostingTariffs
Live GPS map view with truck-position cards + fleet utilization tiles
Excel bulk import / export via maatwebsite/excel + mavinoo/laravel-batch
